limitations: Ground field C, genus at least three, general degree-(g+4) polarization with balanced direct image, ambient projective dimension four. The three extensions are not claimed to split. Earlier implicit derivations remain possible. Independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_integrity: The theorem computes the complete HN filtration for a general complete embedding of any fixed smooth hyperelliptic genus at least three curve into projective four-space. The cubic-scroll geometry and destabilizing scroll line were known; the low-rank second HN step is the proposed new refinement. The proof is a geometric argument using normal and evaluation exact sequences. The arithmetic checker is supplementary and does not verify geometric exactness.
title: Harder–Narasimhan filtration of complete hyperelliptic curves in projective four-space
